text: Is it not a pleasure to learn and to practice what one has learned?
trans: 学习并经常温习，不也是一件快乐的事吗？
author: Confucius

text: He who reviews the old and comes to know the new is fit to be a teacher.
trans: 温习旧的知识并从中获得新的理解，可以成为老师了。
author: Confucius

text: Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous.
trans: 只学习不思考就会迷惑而无所得，只思考不学习就会精神疲惫而无所获。
author: Confucius

text: They who know it are not equal to those who love it; they who love it are not equal to those who delight in it.
trans: 懂得它的人不如喜爱它的人，喜爱它的人不如以它为乐的人。
author: Confucius

text: When I walk along with two others, they may serve me as my teachers.
trans: 几个人一起行走，其中必定有可以作为我老师的人。
author: Confucius

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
trans: 千里远的行程，是从脚下第一步开始的。
author: Lao Tzu

text: As heaven's movement is vigorous, so the gentleman ceaselessly strengthens himself.
trans: 天的运行刚强劲健，君子应效法它，不断自我奋发图强。
author: King Wen of Zhou

text: The road ahead is long and far, yet I will search high and low for truth.
trans: 前方的道路漫长而遥远，我将上上下下去探索追求。
author: Qu Yuan

text: Skill comes from diligence and is lost in play; conduct is shaped by thought and ruined by carelessness.
trans: 学业靠勤奋才能精湛，沉迷玩乐就会荒废；德行靠思考才能养成，随波逐流就会毁掉。
author: Han Yu

text: When young, we do not know the value of studying early; when old, we regret having started too late.
trans: 年轻时不知道勤奋学习，等到老了才后悔读书太迟。
author: Yan Zhenqing

text: Having read ten thousand books, one writes as if inspired by the gods.
trans: 读书超过万卷，下笔时如有神助。
author: Du Fu

text: Read widely but take what is essential; accumulate richly but release it sparingly.
trans: 广泛观察而简要地取用，丰厚积累而少量地释放。
author: Su Shi

text: Without accumulating small steps, one cannot reach a thousand miles; without gathering small streams, one cannot form rivers and seas.
trans: 不积累每一小步，就无法到达千里；不汇聚每一细流，就无法形成江海。
author: Xunzi

text: The sword's edge comes from grinding; the plum blossom's fragrance comes from bitter cold.
trans: 宝剑的锐利是从反复磨砺中得来的，梅花的香气是在严寒中孕育的。
work: Wise Words to Warn the World
author: Chinese Proverb

text: A time will come to ride the wind and cleave the waves; I will set my cloud-like sail and cross the boundless sea.
trans: 相信乘风破浪的时机定会到来，到时定要扬起征帆横渡沧海。
author: Li Bai

text: If one does not strive in youth, one will grieve in vain in old age.
trans: 年轻力壮时不努力奋斗，到老年时只有徒然悲伤。
author: Han Yuefu

text: Beside the sunken boat, a thousand sails pass by; ahead of the withered tree, ten thousand trees bloom in spring.
trans: 沉船旁边，千帆竞发；病树前头，万木争春。
author: Liu Yuxi

text: Where hills and streams seem to leave no way ahead, willows and flowers reveal another village.
trans: 山峦重叠水流曲折让人怀疑无路可走，却在柳暗花明处出现一个村庄。
author: Lu You

text: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
trans: 我们都生活在阴沟里，但仍有人仰望星空。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
trans: 生存还是毁灭，这是一个问题。
author: William Shakespeare

text: What's in a name? That which we call a rose by any other name would smell as sweet.
trans: 名字算什么？玫瑰不叫玫瑰，依然芳香如故。
author: William Shakespeare

text: A man can be destroyed but not defeated.
trans: 一个人可以被毁灭，但不能被打败。
work: The Old Man and the Sea
author: Ernest Hemingway

text: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
trans: 只有用心才能看清；本质的东西用眼睛是看不见的。
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
trans: 凡是有钱的单身汉，总想娶位太太，这是一条举世公认的真理。
author: Jane Austen

text: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me: I am a free human being with an independent will.
trans: 我不是鸟，也没有落进罗网。我是一个有独立意志的自由人。
author: Charlotte Brontë

text: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
trans: 于是我们奋力向前，逆水行舟，被不断地向后推，直至回到往昔岁月。
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

text: After all, tomorrow is another day.
trans: 毕竟，明天又是新的一天。
author: Margaret Mitchell

text: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
trans: 这是最好的时代，也是最坏的时代。
author: Charles Dickens

text: For you, a thousand times over.
trans: 为你，千千万万遍。
author: Khaled Hosseini

text: Carpe diem. Seize the day, boys. Make your lives extraordinary.
trans: 把握今朝。抓住今天，孩子们，让你们的生命与众不同。
author: John Keating

text: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
trans: 未来属于那些相信梦想之美的人。
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

text: Be the change you wish to see in the world.
trans: 成为你希望在世界上看到的改变。
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: I think, therefore I am.
trans: 我思故我在。
author: René Descartes

text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
trans: 未经审视的人生是不值得过的。
author: Socrates

text: Knowledge is power.
trans: 知识就是力量。
author: Francis Bacon

text: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
trans: 求知若饥，虚心若愚。
author: Steve Jobs

text: Fear not the floating clouds that block your sight, for you stand on the highest peak.
trans: 不怕浮云挡住视野，因为我正站在最高处。
author: Wang Anshi

text: The sea admits a hundred rivers, for its capacity to hold is great.
trans: 大海之所以浩瀚，是因为它能容纳百川。
author: Lin Zexu
